cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — kneeling on the ground; The wooden rigging deck of a community puppet theatre after a rehearsal — She mends a miniature moon prop with a strip of rice paper; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds her keepsake up beside her face; An open courtyard at a handmade paper mill — She holds a handmade sheet toward the sun and follows seven pale mulberry fibres with her free index finger; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — kneeling on the ground; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — standing close to a high shelf or line; a retro American diner — standing; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — looks into a small brass telescope; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — sitting on the ground; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds her keepsake up beside her face
